  E.Nonempty →
    ScaleLaws ∧ CriticalLaws ∧ InvarianceLaws ∧ PowerLaws →
      ((∃ R, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (j : Fin n), |x.ofLp j| ≤ R) ∧
          Bornology.IsBounded E ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → content s δ E < ∞) →
        ∀ (R h : ℝ),

                have t := fun f => {x | ∀ (j : Fin n), x.ofLp j ∈ Icc (-R + ↑↑(f j) * w) (-R + (↑↑(f j) + 1) * w)};
